source:
@@U00534@@
I'm not sure I understand.

@@U00536@@
You'll get the hang of it in time,
once you've learned to analyze and classify.

@@U00538@@
All this confuses me so.
I feel as if a millwheel were turning in my head.

@@U00540@@
Next, and before all else,
you must tackle metaphysics—
metaphysics that will put in your head ideas
too vast for the human brain to consider.
And whether they fit or whether they don't,
doesn’t matter, really;
you'll always come up with some
pompous word or other
you can use to describe them.
Now:
this first semester you must work
according to an ironbound schedule.
You'll attend five classes daily;
you'll be there at the stroke of the bell,
and no absences;
you'll be prepared;
you'll do your homework beforehand,
and that way you'll know,
without consulting the text,
that the professor’s not adding things that aren’t in the book.
And be certain you write down his every syllable
as if it came straight from the Holy Ghost.

@@U00542@@
That you wont have to tell me twice!
I can see the use of it.
translation:
@@U00534@@
我不确定我是否理解。

@@U00536@@
到时候你就会掌握窍门的
一旦你学会了分析和分类。

@@U00538@@
这一切让我很困惑。
我感觉脑子里好像有一个水车在转动。

@@U00540@@
接下来，也是在所有其他事情之前，
你必须解决形而上学——
形而上学将把想法放入你的头脑中
太大了，人类大脑无法考虑。
不管他们适合还是不适合，
真的没关系；
你总会想出一些
浮夸的词或其他
你可以用它来描述它们。
现在：
第一个学期你必须工作
根据铁界时间表。
您每天将参加五节课；
铃声一响你就会到那里
并且没有缺席情况；
你会做好准备的；
你会提前做好功课
这样你就会知道，
无需查阅文本，
教授没有添加书中没有的内容。
并且一定要写下他的每一个音节
仿佛它直接来自圣灵。

@@U00542@@
你不必告诉我两次！
我可以看到它的用途。
